name: LiquidGradient
description: A Canvas 2D fluid color field: eight Lissajous attractors blended by inverse-distance weighting through a domain-warped coordinate space, rendered at low resolution and smoothly upscaled for a liquid look.
a11yNotes: The canvas and sheen are aria-hidden decorative layers; text sits above in normal flow. The render loop stops off-screen or at speed 0, and prefers-reduced-motion draws a single static frame. Resizes via ResizeObserver with devicePixelRatio capped at 2.

propsApi.name: scale
propsApi.description: Size of the fluid features; higher = larger, calmer pools (0.3–3).

propsApi.name: softness
propsApi.description: Edge softness between colors; 0 = sharp cells, 1 = fully blended.

propsApi.name: height
propsApi.description: Height of the background in px.

propsApi.name: children
propsApi.description: Content rendered centered on top; defaults to a heading and subline.

propsApi.name: className
propsApi.description: Additional class merged onto the root element.

propsApi.name: style
propsApi.description: Inline styles merged onto the root element.
